threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still use your phone to check bus times instead of just looking at the stop. Real locals know the buses run on vibes.
Caught a night bus from Brixton to Clapham and a guy in a parrot costume just sat down, chatting with a sleeping stranger. Only in London.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh döner mingling with diesel fumes from the bus in Hermannplatz on a Friday evening. That's when it hit me—this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a random art installation made out of old bikes in the park, accompanied by spontaneous dance-offs every weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to avoid Civic Center when smoke alarms go off; tourists think it’s just part of the experience. No one’s rushing to the station.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a couple share a bottle of wine while waiting for the 21 to show. No one batted an eye, just another day in the 'Loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists keep asking for 'authentic' tapas but miss that the real vibe is in the late-night pinchos at locals’ bars, not the menus.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by how they gawk at the metro map, struggling with the different lines like it’s a treasure map, while locals zip by without a second glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You say 'the Tube' without knowing any lines, and you’re still amazed at the number of coffee shops on every corner.
Caught a night bus from Brixton last week. A group of kids started a spontaneous dance party in the back, whole bus joined in. Pure South London magic.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Caught a bus in the middle of a strike, yet the driver still took the time to help a lost tourist. That’s when I knew I'd found my home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find techno raves in old factories, where the soundtrack blends with the sound of trains passing by at dawn.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local if they know to avoid Civic Center during BART meltdowns and still get stuck in Muni delays caused by a dog on the tracks.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: You haven’t truly experienced Muni until you've shared a bus ride with a magician performing card tricks—while the bus is stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think Gràcia is all about the parks and cafes, but few notice the antique shops tucked away—real hidden gems often ignored.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they order a 'café con leche'—it's always with a rushed 'por favor' like they expect it to be served on a silver platter.
